tickets.title: Freeze evidence, source-window, and closure rules
tickets.delivers: A reviewed contract and worked examples define exactly which committed evidence the compiler may process and cite.

tickets.title: Freeze durable work, coverage, and generation transitions
tickets.delivers: A state and transition contract makes scheduling, recovery, coverage gaps, and generation changes unambiguous.

tickets.title: Freeze owner review after source sessions close
tickets.delivers: Exact approval, edit, rejection, and batch scenarios define how durable candidates become accepted knowledge.

tickets.title: Measure a local extractor on reviewed evaluation data
tickets.delivers: A repeatable local experiment selects a model/runtime/schema using reviewed data and a frozen evaluation protocol.
tickets.implementation_note: Schema corrected;110 frozen comparisons. Human output adjudication/model adequacy pending.

tickets.title: Compile one selected source unit into durable candidates
tickets.delivers: An explicitly selected owner assertion produces an inspectable, persisted candidate or an explicit successful empty result.
tickets.implementation_note: Deterministic bounded compiler/CLI/transport verified and committed. Selected runtime quality criterion remains open.

tickets.title: Recover unfinished compilation safely across processes
tickets.delivers: Restart, retry, cancellation, and competing processes preserve durable work without duplicate or stale outcomes.
tickets.implementation_note: Ticket137 complete. Final independent Standards/Spec, isolated full verification and focused race suite passed.

tickets.title: Activate background compilation for new evidence
tickets.delivers: The owner activates a generation at an explicit frontier while conversations finish independently of extraction.
tickets.implementation_note: Ticket138 complete after final independent Standards/Spec rereviews and isolated full verification; focused race regressions passed.

tickets.title: Select historical backfill and inspect honest coverage
tickets.delivers: The owner selects bounded historical ranges, sees gaps and outside-selection history, and keeps recent work progressing.
tickets.implementation_note: Ticket 139 complete. Final independent Standards/Spec rereviews, full isolated verification, and focused normal/race checks passed; unavailable scopes retain pending work without starving independent requests.

tickets.title: Accept or reject a candidate after its conversation closes
tickets.delivers: The owner reviews one exact simple candidate through the CLI and commits replayable knowledge or a durable rejection.
tickets.implementation_note: Final terminal-resolution ordering, promotion provenance, historical replay regressions pass independent Standards and Spec review and full isolated verification.

tickets.title: Review people, relationships, and new Predicate definitions
tickets.delivers: Candidates can propose relationships while exposing identity ambiguity and every necessary graph-definition effect.
tickets.implementation_note: Ticket141 complete after final independent Standards/Spec, isolated full verification, and focused race checks.

tickets.title: Review temporal changes, corrections, and additional support
tickets.delivers: The owner can review meaningful changes without losing uncertainty, prior history, or the distinction between errors and changed circumstances.
tickets.implementation_note: Ticket142 complete. Independent Standards/Spec, full isolated verification and focused normal/race checks passed.

tickets.title: Compile and review the initial contracted tool observation
tickets.delivers: A specifically allowed completed tool observation becomes a sourced candidate while retaining its original authority.
tickets.implementation_note: Ticket 143 complete. Final independent Standards/Spec rereviews, full isolated verification, and focused normal/race checks passed. Infrastructure read failures retain retryable queued work.

tickets.title: Edit candidates and approve bounded dependent batches
tickets.delivers: The owner can correct a proposal or review an efficient batch while seeing exact dependencies and preserving its origin.
tickets.implementation_note: Transactional correction schema, immutable edits and bounded batches complete. Final independent Standards/Spec reviews, full isolated verification and focused normal/race checks passed.

tickets.title: Review simple candidates in the web inbox
tickets.delivers: The web owner can inspect, accept or reject a simple candidate with the same scope and approval rules as the CLI.
tickets.implementation_note: Ticket145 complete. Final independent Standards/Spec rereviews, full isolated verification, frontend and browser acceptance/rejection checks passed.

tickets.title: Review identities, edits, and compound effects on the web
tickets.delivers: The web inbox supports the full reviewed candidate vocabulary, including ambiguity, edits and bounded batches.
tickets.implementation_note: Advanced web review and mixed interpretation history complete. Final independent reviews, isolated full checks, 137 frontend tests and actual headless browser flow passed.

tickets.title: Change generations without losing review decisions
tickets.delivers: A new extractor configuration can process explicitly selected evidence while accepted memory and prior review decisions remain intact.
tickets.implementation_note: Exact recurrence/current-effect lineage, native and compound correction regression, bounded migration, full verification and independent Standards/Spec review passed.

tickets.title: Inspect compiler health, coverage, and review backlog
tickets.delivers: Safe CLI and web diagnostics show why work is waiting and provide the measurements needed for the real pilot.
tickets.implementation_note: Bounded exact-scope health/status, real timings and failed-output preservation; full checks, UI tests, actual browser and both independent reviews passed. Separate pre-existing task timestamp-ordering defect retained as limitation.

tickets.title: Prove the complete Stage 4 path with deterministic acceptance
tickets.delivers: A reproducible acceptance run proves foreground independence, restart recovery, closed-session review and replay across surfaces.
tickets.implementation_note: Final independent Standards/Spec review, seven-scope real browser, normal/race conformance, full repository verification and 155 UI tests pass. Exact source-bound report retained; no learned or pilot claims.

tickets.title: Run the integrated pilot and freeze release gates
tickets.delivers: Measured foreground cost, extraction quality, review effort and scaling establish numerical gates before final evaluation.
tickets.implementation_note: Corrected99-trial infrastructure study, independent reviews and full checks passed. Actual model/owner pilot and numeric gates remain pending.

tickets.title: Evaluate the frozen configuration and declare Stage 4 readiness
tickets.delivers: A final versioned report states whether the frozen Stage 4 configuration passes every agreed gate for ongoing use.
tickets.implementation_note: Evidence-bound offline evaluation tooling and independent reviews/full checks passed. Actual final-model/human/holdout evaluation remains unrun.
